|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Dark Lightning]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

If destiny +2 &gt; target's ability, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn and, if target is Anakin, Luke, or Rey, opponent loses 1 Force (2 Force if a [Skywalker] Epic Event is also on table).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dark Lightning (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 13 October 2026: “Target a character present with your Dark Jedi Master. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 &gt; target's ability, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn and, if target is Anakin, Luke, or Rey, opponent loses 1 Force (2 Force if a [Skywalker] Epic Event is also on table).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Dark Lightning]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Dark Lightning]] (published 9 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•Dark Lightning”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
